questions.question: What law states that energy cannot be created or destroyed?
questions.tutor: First Law: Energy is conserved, only converted from one form to another.

questions.question: What is the efficiency of an ideal heat engine?
questions.tutor: Maximum possible efficiency is Carnot efficiency = 1 - Tc/Th.

questions.question: What is the function of a transformer?
questions.tutor: Transformer transfers electrical energy between circuits by electromagnetic induction.

questions.question: What is the turns ratio of a transformer with 100 primary turns and 1000 secondary turns?
questions.tutor: Turns ratio = Np:Ns = 100:1000 = 1:10.

questions.question: What is the secondary voltage if Vp=120V and turns ratio=1:10?
What type of motor uses a commutator?
questions.tutor: DC motors use commutator to reverse current direction in armature coils.

What is slip in an induction motor?
questions.tutor: Slip s = (Ns - Nr)/Ns, typically 2-5% at full load.

questions.question: What does a generator convert?
questions.tutor: Generator converts mechanical energy into electrical energy.

questions.question: What does a motor convert?
questions.tutor: Motor converts electrical energy into mechanical energy.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a prime mover?
questions.tutor: Prime mover (turbine, engine) supplies mechanical energy to generator.

What is the main loss in a transformer core?
questions.tutor: Core losses (iron losses) are hysteresis and eddy current losses.

questions.question: What material reduces eddy current loss in transformers?
questions.tutor: Laminated silicon steel core reduces eddy current paths.

questions.question: What is the efficiency of a 10 kW motor with 1 kW losses?
What type of battery is rechargeable?
questions.tutor: Lead-acid, NiCd, Li-ion are rechargeable; dry cells are primary.

questions.question: What is the nominal voltage of a single lead-acid cell?
questions.tutor: Lead-acid cell nominal voltage is 2 V.

questions.question: What does an inverter do?
questions.tutor: Inverter converts DC (battery/solar) to AC.

questions.question: What does a rectifier do?
questions.tutor: Rectifier converts AC to DC.

questions.question: What is the voltage regulation of a transformer?
questions.tutor: Voltage regulation measures voltage drop from no-load to full-load.

What is the back EMF of a DC motor at no load?
questions.tutor: At no load, back EMF ≈ Vt, Ia is very small.

questions.question: What is the torque equation of a DC motor?
questions.tutor: Torque T = k × φ × Ia, where k = (PZ)/(2πa).
